title: Does nothing when lit except provide light
text: Does nothing when lit except provide light. When I bought this, it was based on customer reviews - most of which are openly admitted to being sponsored by the company.  I received my candles and the aroma was heavenly, truly.  I LOVED the fragrance.  I lit 1 candle.  Absolutely no scent.  I moved the candle closer and closer, waiting.  Even a foot away, the candle did not emit any fragrance which made the immediate atmosphere more pleasant.  I was hugely disappointed.  It's better to just set the unlit candles out near you and enjoy the pleasant aroma, because lighting them serves no purpose except to give you candlelight. I had left feedback for the seller who never bothered to replace the product or offer a refund or even send a reply.  I won't be buying these again.

product_metadata.title: Mango & Papaya Premium Tealight Candles - 6 Orange Highly Scented Tea Lights - Beautiful Candlelight - Made in The USA - Fruit & Berry Collection
features: Our Mango & Papaya Tealight Candles feature a clear cup and are designed to provide beautiful bright light in all traditional tea light candle holders.
Made in the USA with natural and essential oils, and a clean burning natural fiber single lead free wick - completely non toxic!
Our Mango & Papaya Tea lights are hand poured with our classic food grade natural paraffin wax blend for great scent throw.
All of our Fruit tealights are highly scented and designed to burn all the way to the edge and bottom with a good scent throw.
Each pack contains 6 Tea Light Candles 1.5 inches in diameter, each with 1/2 Oz. of wax, and burn for approximately 5 hours per tea-light.
description: Soak in this 'sweet as honey' scent of perfectly ripe papaya mixed with the strong, sweet, and fruity aroma of the ripest freshly sliced mango. A gift from the sun perfect for any occasion. Our Mango & Papaya tealight candles feature a beautiful clear container that allows the candle color to shine through brilliantly, and a self trimming natural fiber wick. Our Mango & Papaya tea lights will add a luminous splash of color to any home decor, or any event big or small! Each 1/2 Oz. tealight burns for 5+ hours, and pack a great scent throw for such a small package. Our classic container wax is composed of a super soft paraffin petrolatum blend with a low melt point making for strong fragrance fast.
